description: Find train connections between two Belgian railway stations — returns up to 10 journeys with departure/arrival times, total duration, delays, transfer stations (vias), train numbers, platform numbers, and cancellation flags. Supports departure or arrival time selection. No auth required. Data: iRail real-time SNCB/NMBS Belgium train data.

date.description: Date in DDMMYY format (e.g. "290626" for 29 June 2026). Defaults to today.

from.description: Departure station name (e.g. "Brussel-Zuid", "Gent-Sint-Pieters"). Must match Belgian spelling.

lang.description: Language for station and direction names. Default: en.

results.description: Number of connections to return (1–10). Default: 6.

time.description: Time in HHMM format (e.g. "1430" for 14:30). Defaults to current time.

timesel.description: Whether the provided time is the desired departure time or arrival time. Default: depart.

to.description: Arrival station name (e.g. "Antwerpen-Centraal", "Brugge"). Must match Belgian spelling.

name: irail.transit.connections

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: iRail Train Connections
